MODEL PROPOSAL · TERRAIN EDIT
“A ~300 m ridge along the stroke”
1. Ridge along the painted stroke, crest 300 m high (smooth falloff, softness 1)
Preview (worked out by the app on a copy of the region; nothing has changed):
    Heights in the region (metres above sea): lowest 1300 m to 1300 m, mean 2260 m to 2315 m, highest 6594 m to 6594 m.
    2616 cells change; largest rise 299 m, largest fall 0 m.
    11 cells would be stopped at the world's ceiling, so they rise less than asked.
